description_en: Retrieves the list of pending permission request orders for which the current user is the approver
description_zh: 获取当前用户作为审批人、待处理的权限申请单列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-pending-approvals --def-schema MaxCompute --resource-type table --resource '{"DefSchema":"MaxCompute","DefVersion":"v1.0.0","MetaData":{"key":"example-string"}}' --start-time 1771948800000 --end-time 1779724799999 --grantee PrincipalId=ROLE_3133343434 PrincipalType=RamRole --access-types select --next-token eyJpZCI6MTIzfQ== --page-size 20 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPendingApprovals
